ir.intuition: Reference builder: all winner/loser pairs by objective ordering.

ir.name: pairwise_rankprob_advantage_gap_weighted_log_softmax_normalized
ir.intuition: Instead of modeling pairwise margin losses via margin-based links, this loss implements a probabilistic ranking approach using the log-softmax over pair logits combined with advantage_gap signal. This shifts the paradigm from margin-based losses to a probabilistic rank distribution, normalizing weights via log-sum-exp for stable weighting. The loss encourages the model to assign higher probability to the winning log-prob with respect to the losing log-prob, modulated by advantage_gap and normalized weights to handle instance importance robustly.
ir.pseudocode:
diff = log_prob_w - log_prob_l
weight_norm = weight - logsumexp(weight)
weighted_log_prob = (diff + beta * advantage_gap) + weight_norm
loss = -mean(weighted_log_prob)
return loss
ir.code:
def generated_loss(batch, model_output, extra):
    lpw = batch['log_prob_w']
    lpl = batch['log_prob_l']
    weight = batch['weight']
    advantage_gap = batch['advantage_gap']

    beta = float(extra.get('beta', extra.get('hyperparams', {}).get('beta', 1.0)))
    eps = 1e-12

    diff = ops.sub(lpw, lpl)  # shape: [batch_size]

    # Normalize weights using logsumexp for stability
    max_weight = ops.max(weight)
    weight_stable = ops.sub(weight, max_weight)
    weight_exp = ops.exp(weight_stable)
    weight_exp_sum = ops.sum(weight_exp)
    logsumexp_weight = ops.add(max_weight, ops.log(ops.add(weight_exp_sum, eps)))

    weight_norm = ops.sub(weight, logsumexp_weight)  # log scale normalized weights

    margin_score = ops.add(diff, ops.mul(beta, advantage_gap))

    weighted_log_prob = ops.add(margin_score, weight_norm)

    loss = ops.neg(ops.mean(weighted_log_prob))

    return loss
